Incoterms 2020

Servicio de Practicaje

A compulsory port or channel navigation service provided by licensed marine pilots to guide vessels safely into, within, or out of ports and through hazardous waters.

Quick answer: A compulsory port or channel navigation service provided by licensed marine pilots to guide vessels safely into, within, or out of ports and through hazardous waters.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Servicio de Practicaje?

In this glossary, Servicio de Practicaje refers to: A compulsory port or channel navigation service provided by licensed marine pilots to guide vessels safely into, within, or out of ports and through hazardous waters.

How is Servicio de Practicaje used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "El servicio de practicaje es obligatorio para todos los buques grandes que ingresan al puerto para garantizar una navegación segura por los canales estrechos."

Why does Servicio de Practicaje matter in logistics?

Servicio de Practicaje matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Servicio de Practicaje?

Servicio de Practicaje is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A compulsory port or channel navigation service provided by licensed marine pilots to guide vessels safely into, within, or out of ports and through hazardous waters.

Operational example

Pilotage service is required for all large vessels entering the port to ensure safe navigation through narrow channels.

Localized term

Localized example
